title: Second Conditional: More Practice — Quiz 80
content:
## Second Conditional: More Practice

Choose past simple and would for imaginary situations.

### Lesson focus

1. If it ___, we would stay at home. (rained / had rained)
2. If I were you I ___ home immediately. (would go / would have gone)
3. He ___ look a lot better if he shaved more often. (will / would)
4. If I ___ wings, I would fly like a bird. (had / had had)

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
